shooterExperience.description: TST-12 17.5 x 23 is a twelve-station SCZN3 practice target using the Founder-approved 60-shot course.

shooterExperience.authorityLimitations: SCZN3 practice scoring only. Not competition certification. First Baker physical print remains subject to measured acceptance against the UGO specification.
